summary: Reviewed 36 sources, 269 evidence/snippet items, and 50 entities: 30 publish, 18 publish_flagged, 2 reject. Rejected IBM Aachen and Berlin because the cited plan pages never link those eu-de backends to paid access. Corrected five stale volatile IBM backend quotes and three under-specific Pasqal billing quotes. Flagged Azure's still-listed Aria 1 against IonQ's retired status; IQM's device-to-free-plan ambiguity; OQC's contact-only tier inference; and several HQ designations not expressly stated by their address pages. All four snippets were verbatim; three local checks passed and IonQ remained not_run because a token is required.
